purpose: Generate evidence-based learning and engineering paths for every capability using O*NET, professional standards, open-source references, public benchmarks, and DreamCo advancement goals.
mastery_gate: No capability is considered mastered until executable tests, benchmark evidence, professional-quality evidence where applicable, and holdout evidence meet its defined threshold.
advancement_gate: After parity is demonstrated, create a harder DreamCo challenge before marking the learning path complete.
score_policy: Scores describe tested distributions and should never be interpreted as universal intelligence or occupational certification.
